family.description: Members of this protein family are essentially universal in the class Clostidia and therefore highly abundant in the human gut microbiome. This short peptide is designated SCIFF, for Six Cysteines in Forty-Five residues. It is a presumed ribosomal natural product precursor, always found associated with a yet-uncharacterised radical SAM protein that resembles other peptide modification radical SAM enzymes and is designated SCIFF radical SAM maturase [[cite:PUB00055953]].
family.name: Six-cysteine peptide SCIFF
